goal: Maximize official MIB doc challenge deterministic score (target 150/150)
selection_policy: Keep decisions use dev_score (rules tuned on dev 70%). holdout_score is the honest ensemble report (dev-trained hybrid model, untouched 30%); consulted as guard only — a keep that tanks holdout by >1.0 is reverted as overfit.
notes: Evaluation is cache-based (cache/evidence2 OCR lines re-enriched at predict time). Changes to extract-time OCR code need targeted re-extraction and a dedicated experiment protocol; prefer predict-time logic (parsing, resolution, flags, adjudication, calibration).
